test_putaway_storage_category_routes_packaged_receipttest_warehouse_routing.py · TestPutaway
    def test_putaway_storage_category_routes_packaged_receipt(self):
        """ A storage-category putaway rule filtered by package type also
        routes a packaged receipt once it's actually in that package - the
        final location lands on the package itself, not just the move
        line. """
        storage_category = self.env['stock.storage.category'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'name': 'Storage category'})
        package_type = self.env['stock.package.type'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'name': 'Package Type'})
        child_loc = self._create_location('Child Location', storage_category_id=storage_category.id)
        package = self.env['stock.package'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'package_type_id': package_type.id})
        self.env['stock.putaway.rule'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'product_id': self.product.id,
            'location_in_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_out_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'storage_category_id': storage_category.id,
            'package_type_ids': [Command.link(package_type.id)],
            'sublocation': 'closest_location',
        })

        move = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=100)
        move._action_confirm()
        move.move_line_ids.quantity = 100
        move.picked = True
        move.move_line_ids.action_put_in_pack(package_id=package.id)
        move._action_done()

        self.assertEqual(package.location_id, child_loc)

    def test_putaway_storage_category_package_capacity_blocks_once_full(self):
        """ A storage category's per-package-type capacity (distinct from
        the per-product quantity capacity) lets one package of that type in,
        then blocks the next one once the sublocation is full. """
        package_type = self.env['stock.package.type'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'name': 'Package Type'})
        storage_category = self.env['stock.storage.category'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'name': 'Storage category',
            'capacity_ids': [Command.create({'package_type_id': package_type.id, 'quantity': 1})],
        })
        child_loc = self._create_location('Child Location', storage_category_id=storage_category.id)
        self.env['stock.putaway.rule'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'product_id': self.product.id,
            'location_in_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_out_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'storage_category_id': storage_category.id,
            'package_type_ids': [Command.link(package_type.id)],
            'sublocation': 'closest_location',
        })

        package1 = self.env['stock.package'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'package_type_id': package_type.id})
        move1 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=100)
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1.move_line_ids.quantity = 100
        move1.picked = True
        move1.move_line_ids.action_put_in_pack(package_id=package1.id)
        move1._action_done()
        self.assertEqual(package1.location_id, child_loc)

        package2 = self.env['stock.package'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({'package_type_id': package_type.id})
        move2 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=100)
        move2._action_confirm()
        move2.move_line_ids.quantity = 100
        move2.picked = True
        move2.move_line_ids.action_put_in_pack(package_id=package2.id)
        move2._action_done()
        self.assertEqual(package2.location_id, self.stock_location)

    def test_putaway_storage_category_max_weight_blocks_once_exceeded(self):
        """ A storage category's max weight caps how much of a weighted
        product its sublocation can take - the putaway stops applying once
        that weight would be exceeded, regardless of unit count. """
        self.product.with_user(self.user_stock_manager).weight = 1
        storage_category = self.env['stock.storage.category'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'name': 'Storage category',
            'max_weight': 100,
        })
        child_loc = self._create_location('Child Location', storage_category_id=storage_category.id)
        self.env['stock.putaway.rule'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'product_id': self.product.id,
            'location_in_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_out_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'storage_category_id': storage_category.id,

    def test_putaway_rule_with_last_used_sublocation(self):
        '''
        1. Create a putaway rule with 'last_used' sublocation
        2. Initial 'store_to' location is 'WH/Stock'
        3. Create a move with a destinaltion location set to 'WH/Stock', then confirm the move
        4. Set destination location of move line to 'shelf_1'
        5. Create another move with a destinaltion location set to 'WH/Stock', then confirm the move
        6. Assert the destination location of move line is set to 'shelf_1'
        '''
        # putaway from stock to child location with storage_category
        putaway = self.env['stock.putaway.rule'].create({
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'location_in_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_out_id': self.stock_location.id,
        })

        self.stock_location.write({
            'putaway_rule_ids': [(4, putaway.id, 0)],
        })

        # first move
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(move1.move_line_ids[0].location_dest_id, self.stock_location)
        move1.move_line_ids[0].location_dest_id = self.shelf_1
        self.assertEqual(move1.state, 'assigned')
        self.assertEqual(len(move1.move_line_ids), 1)
        move1._action_done()

        # second move
        move2 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })
        move2._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(move1.state, 'assigned')
        self.assertEqual(len(move2.move_line_ids), 1)

        self.assertEqual(move2.move_line_ids.location_dest_id.id, self.stock_location.id)
test_putaway_rule_remembers_last_used_sublocationtest_warehouse_routing.py · TestPutaway
    def test_putaway_rule_remembers_last_used_sublocation(self):
        """ A `last_used` putaway rule routes the first receipt to its
        generic `location_out_id`; once a move line's destination is
        manually overridden to a sublocation and done, the next receipt
        is routed there automatically instead. """
        child_loc = self._create_location('Child Location')
        self.env['stock.putaway.rule'].with_user(self.user_stock_manager).create({
            'product_id': self.product.id,
            'location_in_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_out_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'sublocation': 'last_used',
        })

        move1 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        move1._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(move1.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, self.stock_location)
        move1.move_line_ids.location_dest_id = child_loc
        self._validate_move(move1)

        move2 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        move2._action_confirm()

        self.assertEqual(move2.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, child_loc)

    def test_edit_done_move_line_1(self):
        """ Test that editing a done stock move line linked to an untracked product correctly and
        directly adapts the transfer. In this case, we edit the sublocation where we take the
        product to another sublocation where a product is available.
        """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_1, 1.0)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_2, 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_1), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_2), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location), 2.0)

        # move from shelf_1
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1._action_assign()
        move1.move_line_ids.quantity = 1
        move1.picked = True
        move1._action_done()

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_1), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_2), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location), 1.0)

        # edit once done, we actually moved from shelf_2
        move1.move_line_ids.location_id = self.shelf_2

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_1), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.shelf_2), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location), 1.0)

    def test_edit_done_move_line_follows_location_change(self):
        """ Editing a done move line's location to another sub-location
        where stock is available immediately re-syncs the quants there -
        same as editing a reserved line, just after validation instead of
        before. """
        shelf_1 = self._create_location('Shelf 1')
        shelf_2 = self._create_location('Shelf 2')
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, shelf_1, 1)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, shelf_2, 1)

        move = self._out_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=1)
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {shelf_1: 0, shelf_2: 1})

        move.move_line_ids.location_id = shelf_2

        self._check_inventory(self.product, {shelf_1: 1, shelf_2: 0})

    def test_edit_done_move_line_location_steals_other_moves_reservation(self):
        """ Editing a done move line's source location to a sub-location
        another move has reserved steals that reservation - the other move
        re-reserves itself from wherever stock is actually available,
        including the location just vacated. """
        shelf_1 = self._create_location('Shelf 1')
        shelf_2 = self._create_location('Shelf 2')
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, shelf_1, 1)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, shelf_2, 1)

        move1 = self._out_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=1)

        move2 = self._out_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=1, validate=False)
        move2._action_confirm()
        move2._action_assign()
        self.assertEqual(move2.state, 'assigned')
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {shelf_1: 0, shelf_2: 0})

        move1.move_line_ids.location_id = shelf_2

        self._check_inventory(self.product, {shelf_1: 0, shelf_2: 0})
        self.assertEqual(move2.state, 'assigned')
        self.assertEqual(move2.move_line_ids.location_id, shelf_1)

    def test_edit_done_incoming_move_line_quantity_zeroed_undoes_quant(self):
        """ Zeroing a done move line's quantity on an incoming move exactly
        undoes what it had put in stock, landing back at 0 - not negative,
        since there's nothing to "give back" the other way the way an
        outgoing move's source location does. """
        move = self._in_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=10)
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 10})

        move.move_line_ids.quantity = 0

        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 0})
        self.assertEqual(move.product_uom_qty, 10)

    def test_mixed_tracking_reservation_3(self):
        """ Send two products tracked by lot to a customer. In your stock, there two tracked quants
        and two untracked. Once the move is validated, add move lines to also move the two untracked
        ones and assign them serial numbers on the fly. The final quantity in stock should be 0, not
        negative.
        """

            'name': 'lot1',
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
        })

            'name': 'lot2',

        })

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1, lot_id=lot2)

            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1._action_assign()
        move1.move_line_ids.write({'quantity': 1.0})
        move1.picked = True
        move1._action_done()

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 2)

            'move_id': move1.id,

    def test_mixed_tracking_reservation_4(self):
        """ Send two products tracked by lot to a customer. In your stock, there two tracked quants
        and on untracked. Once the move is validated, edit one of the done move line to change the
        serial number to one that is not in stock. The original serial should go back to stock and
        the untracked quant should be tracked on the fly and sent instead.
        """
        lot1 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'lot1',
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
        })
        lot2 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'lot2',
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
        })
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1, lot_id=lot1)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1, lot_id=lot2)

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location), 2.0)
        # creation
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1._action_assign()
        move1.move_line_ids.write({'quantity': 1.0})
        move1.picked = True
        move1._action_done()

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot1, strict=True), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot2, strict=True), 0.0)

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1)
        lot3 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'lot3',
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
        })

        move1.move_line_ids[1].lot_id = lot3

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot1, strict=True), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot2, strict=True), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot3, strict=True), 0.0)
test_edit_done_move_line_lot_to_unavailable_lot_consumes_untracked_quanttest_move.py · TestStockMove
    def test_edit_done_move_line_lot_to_unavailable_lot_consumes_untracked_quant(self):
        """ Editing a done move line's lot to one with no matching quant at
        all doesn't go negative under that lot - it falls back to consuming
        the untracked quant instead, the same way a fresh reservation
        would. """
        lot1 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({'name': 'lot1', 'product_id': self.product_serial.id})
        lot2 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({'name': 'lot2', 'product_id': self.product_serial.id})
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1, lot_id=lot1)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1, lot_id=lot2)

        move = self._out_move(self.product_serial, product_uom_qty=2)
        self._check_inventory(self.product_serial, {self.stock_location: 0})

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.stock_location, 1)
        lot3 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({'name': 'lot3', 'product_id': self.product_serial.id})
        move.move_line_ids[1].lot_id = lot3

        self._check_inventory(self.product_serial, {self.stock_location: 1})
        self._check_inventory(self.product_serial, {self.stock_location: 0}, lot=lot1)
        self._check_inventory(self.product_serial, {self.stock_location: 1}, lot=lot2)
        self._check_inventory(self.product_serial, {self.stock_location: 0}, lot=lot3)

    def test_immediate_validate_2(self):
        """ In a picking with a single partially available move, clicking on validate without
        filling any quantities should open a wizard asking to process all the reservation (so, only
        a part of the initial demand). Validating this wizard should open another one asking for
        the creation of a backorder. If the backorder is created, it should contain the quantities
        not processed.
        """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 5.0)
        picking = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'partner_id': self.partner_1.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
            'state': 'draft',
        })
        self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'picking_id': picking.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 10.0,
        })
        picking.action_confirm()
        picking.action_assign()
        # Only 5 products are reserved on the move of 10, click on `button_validate`.
        res_dict_for_back_order = picking.button_validate()
        self.assertEqual(res_dict_for_back_order.get('res_model'), 'stock.backorder.confirmation')
        backorder_wizard = self.env[(res_dict_for_back_order.get('res_model'))].browse(res_dict_for_back_order.get('res_id')).with_context(res_dict_for_back_order['context'])
        # Chose to create a backorder.
        backorder_wizard.process()

        # Only 5 products should be processed on the initial move.
        self.assertEqual(picking.move_ids.state, 'done')
        self.assertEqual(picking.move_ids.quantity, 5.0)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.gather_relevant(self.productA, self.stock_location)), 0.0)

        # The backoder should contain a move for the other 5 produts.
        backorder = self.env['stock.picking'].search([('backorder_id', '=', picking.id)])
        self.assertEqual(len(backorder), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(backorder.move_ids.product_uom_qty, 5.0)

    def test_immediate_validate_3(self):
        """ In a picking with two moves, one partially available and one unavailable, clicking
        on validate without filling any quantities should open a wizard asking to process all the
        reservation (so, only a part of one of the moves). Validating this wizard should open
        another one asking for the creation of a backorder. If the backorder is created, it should
        contain the quantities not processed.
        """
        product5 = self.env['product.product'].create({
            'name': 'Product 5',
            'is_storable': True,
        })

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 1)

        picking = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.pack_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_int.id,
            'state': 'draft',
        })
        product1_move = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.pack_location.id,
            'picking_id': picking.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 100,
        })
        product5_move = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.pack_location.id,
            'picking_id': picking.id,
            'product_id': product5.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 100,
        })
        picking.action_confirm()
        picking.action_assign()

        # product1_move should be partially available (1/100), product5_move should be totally
        # unavailable (0/100)
        self.assertEqual(product1_move.state, 'partially_available')
        self.assertEqual(product5_move.state, 'confirmed')

        action = picking.button_validate()
        self.assertTrue(isinstance(action, dict), 'Should open backorder wizard')
        self.assertEqual(action.get('res_model'), 'stock.backorder.confirmation')
        wizard = self.env[(action.get('res_model'))].browse(action.get('res_id')).with_context(action.get('context'))
        wizard.process()
        backorder = self.env['stock.picking'].search([('backorder_id', '=', picking.id)])
        self.assertEqual(len(backorder), 1.0)

        # The backorder should contain 99 product1 and 100 product5.
        for backorder_move in backorder.move_ids:
            if backorder_move.product_id.id == self.productA.id:
                self.assertEqual(backorder_move.product_qty, 99)
            elif backorder_move.product_id.id == product5.id:
                self.assertEqual(backorder_move.product_qty, 100)

    def test_validate_picking_with_mixed_availability_backorders_both_moves(self):
        """ A picking with two moves - one partially available, one totally
        unavailable - still opens a single backorder wizard for the whole
        picking; keeping it correctly splits the remainder of both moves
        into the backorder. """
        other_product = self._create_product(name='Other Product')

        destination = self._create_location('Destination')

        ], location_dest_id=destination.id)
        transfer.action_confirm()

        self.assertEqual(
            transfer.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == self.product).state, 'partially_available')
        self.assertEqual(
            transfer.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == other_product).state, 'confirmed')

        action = transfer.button_validate()
        self._process_backorder_wizard(action)

        backorder = self.env['stock.picking'].search([('backorder_id', '=', transfer.id)])
        self.assertEqual(len(backorder), 1)

            backorder.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == self.product).product_uom_qty, 99)

            backorder.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == other_product).product_uom_qty, 100)

    def test_validate_tracked_receipt_requires_lots_unless_picking_type_waives_it(self):
        """ Validating a receipt of tracked products with no serial numbers
        or lots assigned raises a UserError - unless the picking type
        doesn't require assigning new or existing lots/serials at all, in
        which case the done quantity auto-fulfills instead. """

        with self.assertRaises(UserError):

A mixed untracked+lot-tracked receipt blocks (UserError) until the tracked move actually has a lot - merely marking it picked isn't enough. The archive's own test stops at asserting the final wizard pops; I initially over-extended it to assert state == 'done' and it failed against a real DB. Traced the real cause in _pre_action_done_hook() (stock_picking.py ~1292-1311): the auto-pick-all-moves branch only fires when no move in the picking has been picked yet - since the lot move was explicitly picked first to get past the earlier error, the untracked move never gets auto-picked, so it's left for the backorder. Fixed the assertion to match (wizard pops, not processed further) and documented the real mechanism.

    def test_immediate_validate_6(self):
        """ In a receipt picking with two moves, one tracked and one untracked, clicking on
        validate without filling any quantities should displays an UserError as long as no quantity
        done and lot_name is set on the tracked move. Now if the user validates the picking, the
        wizard telling the user all reserved quantities will be processed will NOT be opened. This
        wizard is only opene if no quantities were filled. So validating the picking at this state
        will open another wizard asking for the creation of a backorder. Now, if the user processed
        on the second move more than the reservation, a wizard will ask him to confirm.

test_validate_tracked_receipt_blocks_until_lot_assigned_then_backorderstest_transfer_flow.py · TestTransferFlow
    def test_validate_tracked_receipt_blocks_until_lot_assigned_then_backorders(self):
        """ A receipt mixing an untracked and a lot-tracked move can't be
        validated until the tracked move actually has a lot - merely
        marking it picked isn't enough. Once a lot is assigned, validating
        proceeds to the backorder wizard (the untracked move was never
        marked picked, so it's left for a backorder rather than silently
        auto-completed). """
        self.picking_type_in.with_user(self.user_stock_manager).write({
            'use_create_lots': True,
            'use_existing_lots': False,
        })
        receipt = self._receipt(moves=[
            (self.product, 1), (self.product_lot, 1),
        ], validate=False)
        lot_move = receipt.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == self.product_lot)
        receipt.action_confirm()
        receipt.action_assign()

        with self.assertRaises(UserError):
            receipt.button_validate()

        lot_move.picked = True
        with self.assertRaises(UserError):
            receipt.button_validate()

        lot_move.move_line_ids.lot_name = 'lot1'
        action = receipt.button_validate()

        self.assertEqual(action.get('res_model'), 'stock.backorder.confirmation')

    def test_scrap_updates_uom_aware_reservation(self):
        """ Scrapping some of a product reserved by a move in a coarser UoM
        recomputes that move's own (UoM-converted) reserved quantity. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 11)
        move = self._create_move(
            self.product, self.stock_location, self.customer_location,
            uom_id=self.uom_pack_6.id, product_uom_qty=3)
        move._action_confirm()
        self.assertAlmostEqual(move.quantity, 11 / 6, places=2)

        scrap = self._scrap(self.product, 5)

        self.assertEqual(scrap.state, 'done')
        self.assertAlmostEqual(move.quantity, 1.0, places=2)

    def test_scrap_more_than_available_triggers_insufficient_qty_warning(self):

    def test_scrap_8(self):
        """
        Suppose a user wants to scrap some products thanks to internal moves.
        This test checks the state of the picking based on few cases
        """
        self.picking_type_int.active = True

        product01 = self.productA
        product02 = self.env['product.product'].create({
            'name': 'SuperProduct',
            'is_storable': True,
        })

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(product01, self.stock_location, 3)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(product02, self.stock_location, 1)

        scrap_picking01, scrap_picking02, scrap_picking03 = self.env['stock.picking'].create([{
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.scrap_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_int.id,
            'state': 'draft',
            'move_ids': [(0, 0, {
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
                'location_dest_id': self.scrap_location.id,
                'product_id': product.id,
                'uom_id': product.uom_id.id,
                'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
                'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_int.id,
            }) for product in products],
        } for products in [(product01,), (product01,), (product01, product02)]])

        (scrap_picking01 + scrap_picking02 + scrap_picking03).action_confirm()

        # All SM are processed
        scrap_picking01.move_ids.quantity = 1
        scrap_picking01.move_ids.picked = True
        scrap_picking01.button_validate()

        # All SM are cancelled
        scrap_picking02.action_cancel()

        # Process one SM and cancel the other one
        pick03_prod01_move = scrap_picking03.move_ids.filtered(lambda sm: sm.product_id == product01)
        pick03_prod02_move = scrap_picking03.move_ids - pick03_prod01_move
        pick03_prod01_move.quantity = 1
        pick03_prod02_move._action_cancel()
        scrap_picking03.move_ids.picked = True
        scrap_picking03.button_validate()

        self.assertEqual(scrap_picking01.move_ids.state, 'done')
        self.assertEqual(scrap_picking01.state, 'done')

        self.assertEqual(scrap_picking02.move_ids.state, 'cancel')
        self.assertEqual(scrap_picking02.state, 'cancel')

        self.assertEqual(pick03_prod01_move.state, 'done')
        self.assertEqual(pick03_prod02_move.state, 'cancel')
        self.assertEqual(scrap_picking03.state, 'done')

        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(product01, self.stock_location), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(product02, self.stock_location), 1)

    def test_scrap_from_a_picking_adds_a_second_move(self):
        """ Scrapping linked to a picking adds the scrap as a second move
        on that picking, alongside the original - it doesn't touch or
        replace it, and the picking still validates normally afterward
        with its own reserved quantity untouched. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 10)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[(self.product, 9)], validate=False)
        delivery.action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(delivery.move_ids.quantity, 9)

        scrap = self._scrap(self.product, 1, picking_id=delivery.id)

        all_moves = self.env['stock.move'].search([('picking_id', '=', delivery.id)])
        self.assertEqual(len(all_moves), 2)
        self.assertIn(scrap, all_moves)
        self.assertEqual(scrap.quantity, 1)

        self._validate_picking(delivery, confirm=False, assign=False)

        self.assertEqual(delivery.state, 'done')
        self.assertEqual(delivery.move_ids.quantity, 9)
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.customer_location: 9})

    def test_scrap_move_back_to_stock_restores_quant_cleanly(self):
        """ Moving a reserved quantity's source to the scrap location (as
        if un-scrapping it back to stock) merges cleanly into the existing
        quant there - nothing but the quantity changes, no garbage quant
        left behind at the scrap location. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 10)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.scrap_location, 10)
        move = self._create_move(self.product, self.stock_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=10)
        move._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(move.quantity, 10)

        move.move_line_ids.location_id = self.scrap_location
        self._validate_move(move)

        self.assertEqual(move.state, 'done')
        quant = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product, self.stock_location, strict=True)
        quant_scrap = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product, self.scrap_location)
        self.assertEqual(quant.quantity, 20)
        self.assertFalse(quant_scrap.reserved_quantity)
        self.assertFalse(quant_scrap.quantity)

test_reservation_updates_with_move_quantitytest_move.py · TestStockMove
    def test_reservation_updates_with_move_quantity(self):
        """ Growing or shrinking `move.quantity` recomputes which quants are
        reserved, following the removal strategy (oldest first) across
        several locations, lots, and a package - shrinking releases them
        back in the exact opposite order it grew into them, last reserved
        first freed. """
        shelf_1 = self._create_location('Shelf 1')
        shelf_2 = self._create_location('Shelf 2')
        lot1, lot2, lot3 = self.env['stock.lot'].create([
            {'name': f'lot{index}', 'product_id': self.product_lot.id} for index in range(1, 4)
        ])
        package = self.env['stock.package'].create({'name': 'pack'})
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_lot, shelf_1, 3, lot_id=lot1)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_lot, shelf_2, 3, lot_id=lot2)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_lot, shelf_1, 1, lot_id=lot3)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(
            self.product_lot, shelf_2, 3, lot_id=lot2, package_id=package)

        move = self._out_move(self.product_lot, product_uom_qty=1, validate=False)
        move._action_confirm()
        self.assertRecordValues(move.move_line_ids, [
            {'quantity': 1.0, 'location_id': shelf_1.id, 'lot_id': lot1.id, 'package_id': False},
        ])

        move.quantity = 8
        self.assertRecordValues(move.move_line_ids, [
            {'quantity': 3.0, 'location_id': shelf_1.id, 'lot_id': lot1.id, 'package_id': False},
            {'quantity': 3.0, 'location_id': shelf_2.id, 'lot_id': lot2.id, 'package_id': False},
            {'quantity': 1.0, 'location_id': shelf_1.id, 'lot_id': lot3.id, 'package_id': False},
            {'quantity': 1.0, 'location_id': shelf_2.id, 'lot_id': lot2.id, 'package_id': package.id},
        ])

        move.quantity = 4

        self.assertRecordValues(move.move_line_ids, [
            {'quantity': 3.0, 'location_id': shelf_1.id, 'lot_id': lot1.id, 'package_id': False},
            {'quantity': 1.0, 'location_id': shelf_2.id, 'lot_id': lot2.id, 'package_id': False},
        ])

        move.quantity = 3
        self.assertRecordValues(move.move_line_ids, [
            {'quantity': 3.0, 'location_id': shelf_1.id, 'lot_id': lot1.id, 'package_id': False},
        ])

    def test_in_date_1(self):
        """ Check that moving a tracked quant keeps the incoming date.
        """
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_in.id,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1._action_assign()
        move1.move_line_ids.lot_name = 'lot1'
        move1.picked = True
        move1._action_done()

        quant = self.gather_relevant(self.product_lot, self.stock_location)
        self.assertEqual(len(quant), 1.0)
        self.assertNotEqual(quant.in_date, False)

        # Keep a reference to the initial incoming date in order to compare it later.
        initial_incoming_date = quant.in_date

        move2 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.pack_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })
        move2._action_confirm()
        move2._action_assign()
        move2.picked = True
        move2._action_done()

        quant = self.gather_relevant(self.product_lot, self.pack_location)
        self.assertEqual(len(quant), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(quant.in_date, initial_incoming_date)

    def test_in_date_survives_internal_move(self):
        """ Moving a tracked quant to another location keeps its incoming
        date - an internal transfer doesn't reset it. """
        receipt = self._in_move(self.product_lot, lot_names=['lot1'], product_uom_qty=1)
        lot = receipt.move_line_ids.lot_id
        quant = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot, strict=True)
        self.assertTrue(quant.in_date)
        initial_in_date = quant.in_date

        pack_location = self._create_location('Pack')
        move = self._create_move(self.product_lot, self.stock_location, pack_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        self._validate_move(move)

        quant = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, pack_location, lot_id=lot, strict=True)
        self.assertEqual(quant.in_date, initial_in_date)

    def test_in_date_2(self):
        """ Check that editing a done move line for a tracked product and changing its lot
        correctly restores the original lot with its incoming date and remove the new lot
        with its incoming date.
        """
        lot1 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'lot1',
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
        })
        lot2 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'lot2',
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
        })
        # receive lot1
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_in.id,
        })
        move1._action_confirm()
        move1._action_assign()
        move1.move_line_ids.lot_id = lot1
        move1.picked = True
        move1._action_done()

        # receive lot2
        move2 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_in.id,
        })
        move2._action_confirm()
        move2._action_assign()
        move2.move_line_ids.lot_id = lot2
        move2.picked = True
        move2._action_done()

        initial_in_date_lot2 = self.env['stock.quant'].search([
            ('location_id', '=', self.stock_location.id),
            ('product_id', '=', self.product_lot.id),
            ('lot_id', '=', lot2.id),
        ]).in_date

        # Edit lot1's incoming date.
        quant_lot1 = self.env['stock.quant'].search([
            ('location_id', '=', self.stock_location.id),
            ('product_id', '=', self.product_lot.id),
            ('lot_id', '=', lot1.id),
        ])
        from odoo.fields import Datetime
        from datetime import timedelta
        initial_in_date_lot1 = Datetime.now() - timedelta(days=5)
        quant_lot1.in_date = initial_in_date_lot1

        # Move one quant to pack location
        move3 = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.pack_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_lot.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })
        move3._action_confirm()
        move3._action_assign()
        move3.move_line_ids.quantity = 1
        move3.picked = True
        move3._action_done()
        quant_in_pack = self.env['stock.quant'].search([
            ('product_id', '=', self.product_lot.id),
            ('location_id', '=', self.pack_location.id),
        ])
        # As lot1 has an older date and FIFO is set by default, it's the one that should be
        # in pack.
        self.assertEqual(len(quant_in_pack), 1)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(quant_in_pack.in_date, initial_in_date_lot1, delta=timedelta(seconds=1))
        self.assertEqual(quant_in_pack.lot_id, lot1)

        # Now, edit the move line and actually move the other lot
        move3.move_line_ids.lot_id = lot2

        # Check that lot1 correctly is back to stock with its right in_date
        quant_lot1 = self.env['stock.quant'].search([
            ('location_id.usage', '=', 'internal'),
            ('product_id', '=', self.product_lot.id),
            ('lot_id', '=', lot1.id),
            ('quantity', '!=', 0),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(quant_lot1.location_id, self.stock_location)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(quant_lot1.in_date, initial_in_date_lot1, delta=timedelta(seconds=1))

        # Check that lo2 is in pack with is right in_date
        quant_lot2 = self.env['stock.quant'].search([
            ('location_id.usage', '=', 'internal'),
            ('product_id', '=', self.product_lot.id),
            ('lot_id', '=', lot2.id),
            ('quantity', '!=', 0),
        ])
        self.assertEqual(quant_lot2.location_id, self.pack_location)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(quant_lot2.in_date, initial_in_date_lot2, delta=timedelta(seconds=1))
test_edit_done_move_line_follows_lot_change_keeps_in_dates_correcttest_move.py · TestStockMove
    def test_edit_done_move_line_follows_lot_change_keeps_in_dates_correct(self):
        """ The default removal strategy is FIFO (oldest incoming date
        first) - and editing the resulting done line's lot afterward (see
        `test_edit_done_move_line_follows_lot_change` for the same
        mechanism without the in-date angle) swaps the two quants cleanly,
        each keeping its own incoming date. """
        move_lot1 = self._in_move(self.product_lot, lot_names=['lot1'], product_uom_qty=1)
        move_lot2 = self._in_move(self.product_lot, lot_names=['lot2'], product_uom_qty=1)
        lot1 = move_lot1.move_line_ids.lot_id
        lot2 = move_lot2.move_line_ids.lot_id
        quant_lot1 = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot1, strict=True)
        quant_lot1.in_date = Datetime.now() - timedelta(days=5)
        initial_in_date_lot1 = quant_lot1.in_date
        initial_in_date_lot2 = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(
            self.product_lot, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot2, strict=True).in_date

        pack_location = self._create_location('Pack')
        move = self._create_move(self.product_lot, self.stock_location, pack_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        self._validate_move(move)

        quant_lot1_in_pack = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, pack_location, lot_id=lot1, strict=True)
        self.assertTrue(quant_lot1_in_pack)
        self.assertEqual(quant_lot1_in_pack.in_date, initial_in_date_lot1)
        quant_lot2_untouched = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(
            self.product_lot, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot2, strict=True)
        self.assertEqual(quant_lot2_untouched.quantity, 1)

        move.move_line_ids.lot_id = lot2

        quant_lot1 = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, self.stock_location, lot_id=lot1, strict=True)
        self.assertEqual(quant_lot1.in_date, initial_in_date_lot1)
        quant_lot2 = self.env['stock.quant']._gather(self.product_lot, pack_location, lot_id=lot2, strict=True)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(quant_lot2.in_date, initial_in_date_lot2, delta=timedelta(seconds=1))

test_adding_a_move_line_to_a_picking_creates_its_movetest_transfer_flow.py · TestTransferFlow
    def test_adding_a_move_line_to_a_picking_creates_its_move(self):
        """ Creating a `stock.move.line` directly on a picking (no `move_id`
        set) auto-generates the `stock.move` for it - both while the
        picking is still in progress (if no existing move for that product
        can be linked to instead) and once it's already done (always, even
        for a product that already has a move here). """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 2)
        other_product = self._create_product(name='Other Product')
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(other_product, self.stock_location, 1)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[(self.product, 1)], validate=False)
        delivery.action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(len(delivery.move_ids), 1)

        self.env['stock.move.line'].create({
            'picking_id': delivery.id,
            'product_id': other_product.id,
            'uom_id': other_product.uom_id.id,
            'quantity': 1,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
        })

        self.assertEqual(len(delivery.move_ids), 2)
        added_before_done = delivery.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == other_product)
        self.assertNotEqual(added_before_done.state, 'done')

        self._validate_picking(delivery, confirm=False)

        self.assertEqual(delivery.state, 'done')

        self.env['stock.move.line'].create({
            'picking_id': delivery.id,
            'product_id': self.product.id,
            'uom_id': self.product.uom_id.id,
            'quantity': 1,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
        })

        self.assertEqual(len(delivery.move_ids), 3)
        added_after_done = delivery.move_ids.filtered(lambda m: m.product_id == self.product)
        self.assertEqual(len(added_after_done), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(move.state == 'done' for move in added_after_done))

    def test_put_in_pack_1(self):
        """ Check that completing a move in 2 separate move lines and calling put in pack after
        each ml's creation puts them in different packages. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 2)
        picking = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
            'state': 'draft',
        })
        move1 = self.env['stock.move'].create({

            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
            'picking_id': picking.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
        })
        picking.action_confirm()
        picking.action_assign()
        self.assertEqual(self.env['stock.quant']._get_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location), 0)

        picking.action_put_in_pack()

        self.assertNotEqual(picking.move_line_ids[0].result_package_id, picking.move_line_ids[1].result_package_id)

    def test_put_in_pack_splits_partially_picked_line_into_separate_packages(self):
        """ Calling `action_put_in_pack()` on a partially-picked move packs
        the picked portion and splits off a fresh, unpacked line for what's
        left - calling it again for that remainder packs it into a
        different package, not the same one. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 2)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[(self.product, 2)], validate=False)
        delivery.action_confirm()
        delivery.action_assign()
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 0})

        delivery.move_ids.quantity = 1
        delivery.action_put_in_pack()
        delivery.action_assign()

        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 0})
        self.assertEqual(len(delivery.move_line_ids), 2)
        remaining_line = delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: not ml.result_package_id)
        self.assertEqual(remaining_line.quantity_product_uom, 1)

        remaining_line.quantity = 1
        delivery.action_put_in_pack()

        self.assertEqual(len(delivery.move_line_ids), 2)
        self.assertNotEqual(delivery.move_line_ids[0].result_package_id, delivery.move_line_ids[1].result_package_id)
        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 0})

        delivery.move_ids.picked = True
        delivery.button_validate()

        self._check_inventory(self.product, {self.stock_location: 0, self.customer_location: 2})

    def test_move_line_aggregated_product_quantities(self):
        """ Test the `stock.move.line` method `_get_aggregated_product_quantities`,
        who returns data used to print delivery slips.
        """
        # Creates two other products.
        product2 = self.env['product.product'].create({
            'name': 'Product B',
            'is_storable': True,
        })
        product3 = self.env['product.product'].create({
            'name': 'Product C',
            'is_storable': True,
        })
        # Adds some quantity on stock.
        self.env['stock.quant'].with_context(inventory_mode=True).create([{
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'inventory_quantity': 100,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
        }, {
            'product_id': product2.id,
            'inventory_quantity': 100,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
        }, {
            'product_id': product3.id,
            'inventory_quantity': 100,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
        }]).action_apply_inventory()

        # Not in stock product
        product4 = self.env['product.product'].create({
            'name': 'Product D',
            'is_storable': True,
        })

        # Creates a delivery for a bunch of products.
        delivery_form = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'state': 'draft',
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
        })
        delivery_form = Form(delivery_form)
        with delivery_form.move_ids.new() as move:
            move.product_id = self.productA
            move.product_uom_qty = 10
        with delivery_form.move_ids.new() as move:
            move.product_id = product2
            move.product_uom_qty = 10
            move.description_picking = f"{product2.name}\nDescription2"
        with delivery_form.move_ids.new() as move:
            move.product_id = product3
            move.product_uom_qty = 10
            move.description_picking = f"{product3.display_name}\nDescription3"
        with delivery_form.move_ids.new() as move:
            move.product_id = product4
            move.product_uom_qty = 10
        delivery = delivery_form.save()
        delivery.action_confirm()

        # Delivers a part of the quantity, creates a backorder for the remaining qty.
        delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == self.productA).quantity = 6
        delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == product2).quantity = 2
        delivery.move_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == product4).quantity = 2
        (delivery.move_ids[:2] | delivery.move_ids[3]).picked = True
        backorder_wizard_dict = delivery.button_validate()
        backorder_wizard_form = Form.from_action(self.env, backorder_wizard_dict)
        backorder_wizard_form.save().process()  # Creates the backorder.

        first_backorder = self.env['stock.picking'].search([('backorder_id', '=', delivery.id)], limit=1)
        # Checks the values.
        aggregate_values = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        self.assertEqual(len(aggregate_values), 3)
        sml1 = delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == self.productA)
        sml2 = delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == product2)
        sml3 = delivery.move_line_ids.filtered(lambda ml: ml.product_id == product4)

test_aggregated_quantities_group_multiple_products_with_descriptionstest_reporting.py · TestDeliverySlipReport
    def test_aggregated_quantities_group_multiple_products_with_descriptions(self):
        """ Move lines are grouped by product + description + UoM - the
        same product with and without a line description becomes two
        separate entries, not combined into one; a different product
        groups separately again, regardless of its own description.
        """
        other_product = self._create_product(name='Other Product')
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 10)
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(other_product, self.stock_location, 10)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[
            {
                'product_id': self.product.id, 'product_uom_qty': 5, 'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id, 'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            },
            {
                'product_id': self.product.id, 'product_uom_qty': 3, 'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id, 'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
                'description_picking': 'Gift wrapped',
            },
            {
                'product_id': other_product.id, 'product_uom_qty': 2, 'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id, 'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            },
        ])

        aggregated = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()

        self.assertEqual(len(aggregated), 3)
        key_plain = f'{self.product.id}_{self.product.display_name}__{self.uom_unit.id}_{self.uom_unit.id}'
        key_described = f'{self.product.id}_{self.product.display_name}_Gift wrapped_{self.uom_unit.id}_{self.uom_unit.id}'
        key_other = f'{other_product.id}_{other_product.display_name}__{self.uom_unit.id}_{self.uom_unit.id}'
        self.assertEqual(aggregated[key_plain]['quantity'], 5)
        self.assertEqual(aggregated[key_described]['quantity'], 3)
        self.assertEqual(aggregated[key_described]['description'], 'Gift wrapped')
        self.assertEqual(aggregated[key_other]['quantity'], 2)

    def test_aggregated_quantities_reflect_undelivered_quantities_via_backorder(self):
        """ A product only partially delivered still reports its full
        ordered quantity in the aggregate - the rest is tracked via its
        backorder. """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 10)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[(self.product, 10)], validate=False)
        delivery.action_confirm()
        delivery.action_assign()
        delivery.move_line_ids.quantity = 6
        delivery.move_ids.picked = True

        action = delivery.button_validate()
        self.assertEqual(action.get('res_model'), 'stock.backorder.confirmation')
        self._process_backorder_wizard(action)

        aggregated = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        aggregate_val = next(iter(aggregated.values()))
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val['qty_ordered'], 10)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val['quantity'], 6)

    def test_delivery_slip_aggregated_lines_with_canceled_move_and_packaging(self):
        """
        Ensure that the delivery slip report correctly aggregates product quantities
        when a picking contains both a completed move and a canceled move that uses
        packaging units.
        - two products are ordered in packaging (e.g., 1 pack of 6)
        - the picking is split, causing one move to be fulfilled and the other canceled
        - the canceled move still contributes packaging information (ordered quantity)
        The report must not crash and must return consistent aggregated values.
        """
        pack_of_6 = self.env.ref('uom.product_uom_pack_6')
        # upodate the quantity of product A
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 6)
        picking = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
            'move_ids': [
                Command.create({
                    'product_id': self.productA.id,
                    'product_uom_qty': 1,
                    'uom_id': pack_of_6.id,
                    'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
                    'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
                }),
                Command.create({
                    'product_id': self.productB.id,
                    'product_uom_qty': 1,
                    'uom_id': pack_of_6.id,
                    'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
                    'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
                }),
            ],
        })
        picking.action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(picking.move_ids.mapped('quantity'), [1.0, 0])
        picking.action_split_transfer()
        backorder = picking.backorder_ids
        backorder.action_cancel()
        picking.button_validate()
        self.assertEqual(backorder.state, 'cancel')
        self.assertEqual(picking.state, 'done')
        aggregate_values = picking.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        self.assertEqual(len(aggregate_values), 2)
        aggregate_val_1 = aggregate_values[f'{self.productA.id}_{self.productA.name}__{pack_of_6.id}_{pack_of_6.id}']
        aggregate_val_2 = aggregate_values[f'{self.productB.id}_{self.productB.name}__{pack_of_6.id}_{pack_of_6.id}']
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_1['qty_ordered'], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_1['quantity'], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_1['packaging_qty_ordered'], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_2['qty_ordered'], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_2['quantity'], 0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val_2['packaging_qty_ordered'], 0.0)

    def test_aggregated_quantities_sum_across_duplicate_moves_and_split_lines(self):
        """ Two separate moves for the same product, one of them also
        over-received into a second move line, all collapse into a single
        aggregate entry.
        """
        move1 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=10)
        move2 = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=5)
        (move1 | move2)._action_confirm(merge=False)

        move1.quantity = 13
        self.assertEqual(len(move1.move_line_ids), 2)
        (move1 | move2).picked = True
        (move1 | move2)._action_done()

        aggregated = (move1 | move2).move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        self.assertEqual(len(aggregated), 1)
        aggregate_val = next(iter(aggregated.values()))
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val['qty_ordered'], 15)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate_val['quantity'], 18)

    def test_delivery_slip_quantity_aggregation_across_move_lines(self):
        """ A receipt for a fractional quantity that is over-received in two operations should
        report the expected and received quantities on a single line, both in the product's unit
        and in the vendor's packaging unit.
        """
        pack_of_6 = self.env.ref('uom.product_uom_pack_6')
        receipt = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_in.id,
            'move_ids': [Command.create({
                'product_id': self.productA.id,
                'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
                'product_uom_qty': 11.1,
            })],
        })
        receipt.move_ids.packaging_uom_id = pack_of_6
        receipt.action_confirm()
        # Receiving more than expected adds a second move line for the excess.
        receipt.move_ids.quantity = 13.9
        self.assertEqual(len(receipt.move_ids.move_line_ids), 2)
        receipt.move_ids.picked = True
        receipt.button_validate()

        aggregated_lines = receipt.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        self.assertEqual(len(aggregated_lines), 1)
        aggregate_val = next(iter(aggregated_lines.values()))
        self.assertDictEqual({
            'name': aggregate_val['name'],
            'qty_ordered': aggregate_val['qty_ordered'],
            'quantity': aggregate_val['quantity'],
            'packaging_qty_ordered': aggregate_val['packaging_qty_ordered'],
            'packaging_quantity': aggregate_val['packaging_quantity'],
        }, {
            'name': self.productA.name,
            'qty_ordered': 11.1,
            'quantity': 13.9,
            'packaging_qty_ordered': 1.85,
            'packaging_quantity': 2.32,
        })

test_aggregated_quantities_modes_for_partially_packed_ordertest_reporting.py · TestDeliverySlipReport
    def test_aggregated_quantities_modes_for_partially_packed_order(self):
        """ The three call signatures read a partially-packed order
        differently: the default aggregate still counts the full demand
        even for the not-yet-packed remainder (tracked via the backorder);
        `strict=True` scopes to just what's actually in the package;
        `except_package=True` shows only the not-yet-packed portion
        """
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product, self.stock_location, 25)
        delivery = self._deliver(moves=[(self.product, 15)], validate=False)
        delivery.action_confirm()
        delivery.move_ids.quantity = 5
        delivery.move_ids.picked = True
        delivery.action_put_in_pack()
        package = delivery.move_line_ids.result_package_id

        action = delivery.button_validate()
        self._process_backorder_wizard(action)
        delivery.backorder_ids.action_cancel()

        default_aggregated = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities()
        default_val = next(v for k, v in default_aggregated.items() if k.endswith(f'_{package.id}'))
        self.assertEqual(default_val['qty_ordered'], 15)
        self.assertEqual(default_val['quantity'], 5)

        strict_aggregated = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities(strict=True)
        strict_val = next(iter(strict_aggregated.values()))
        self.assertEqual(strict_val['qty_ordered'], 5)
        self.assertEqual(strict_val['quantity'], 5)

        except_package_aggregated = delivery.move_line_ids._get_aggregated_product_quantities(except_package=True)
        except_val = next(iter(except_package_aggregated.values()))
        self.assertEqual(except_val['qty_ordered'], 10)
        self.assertFalse(except_val['quantity'])

    def test_delivery_slip_quantity_aggregation_with_pack_uom(self):

        """
        pack_of_6 = self.env.ref('uom.product_uom_pack_6')

        receipt = self.env['stock.picking'].create({

    def test_change_move_line_uom(self):
        """Check the reserved_quantity of the quant is correctly updated when changing the UOM in the move line"""
        Quant = self.env['stock.quant']
        Quant._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 100)
        quant = Quant._gather(self.productA, self.stock_location)
        move = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'product_id': self.productA.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1,
            'uom_id': self.productA.uom_id.id,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
        })
        move._action_confirm()
        move._action_assign()
        ml = move.move_line_ids

        # The product's uom is in units, which means we currently have 1 reserved unit
        self.assertEqual(quant.reserved_quantity, 1)

        # Firstly, we test changing the quantity and the uom together: 2 dozens = 24 reserved units
        ml.write({'quantity': 2, 'uom_id': self.uom_dozen.id})
        self.assertEqual(quant.reserved_quantity, 24)
        # Secondly, we test changing only the uom: 2 units -> expected 2 units
        ml.write({'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id})
        self.assertEqual(quant.reserved_quantity, 2)
        self.assertEqual(ml.quantity * self.uom_unit.factor, 2)

    def test_set_quantity_done_with_rounding_issues(self):
        """Imperial UoM can sometime create a discrepancy between the demand and the actual quantity moved,
        this is mostly expected.
        However, when the user force set the quantity manually, a ValidationError could be raised because
        Odoo tried to create a new stock.move.line with the difference and then reserved the 0 quantity.
        This test ensure that a move line with a product uom quantity of 0 does not impact the Quants reserved quantity.
        """
        gram_uom = self.env.ref('uom.product_uom_gram')
        oz_uom = self.env.ref('uom.product_uom_oz')

        self.productA.write({'uom_id': oz_uom.id})
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.productA, self.stock_location, 10)

        delivery = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
            'move_ids': [(0, 0, {
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
                'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
                'product_id': self.productA.id,
                'uom_id': gram_uom.id,
                'product_uom_qty': 150.0,
            })],
        })
        delivery.action_confirm()
        delivery.action_assign()

        self.assertEqual(delivery.move_ids.quantity, 149.97)  # 150 g -> 5.29109 oz -> 5.29 oz -> 149.97 g
        delivery.move_ids.write({'quantity': 150})

        self.assertEqual(delivery.move_ids.quantity, 150)
        delivery.button_validate()
        self.assertEqual(delivery.state, 'done')
        self.assertRecordValues(delivery.move_line_ids, [
            {'quantity': 149.97, 'quantity_product_uom': 5.29},
            {'quantity': 0.03, 'quantity_product_uom': 0},
        ])

    def test_SML_location_selection(self):
        """
        Suppose the setting 'Storage Categories' disabled.
        A user creates an internal transfer from F to T, confirms it then adds a SML and selects
        another destination location L (with L a child of T). When the user completes the field
        `quantity`, the onchange should n't change the destination location L
        """

        self.env.user.write({'group_ids': [(3, self.env.ref('stock.group_stock_multi_locations').id)]})

        picking = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_int.id,
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'state': 'draft',
        })
        self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'product_id': self.product_consu.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
            'picking_id': picking.id,
            'location_id': picking.location_id.id,
            'location_dest_id': picking.location_dest_id.id,
        })

        picking.action_confirm()

        with Form(picking.move_ids, view='stock.view_stock_move_operations') as form:
            with form.move_line_ids.edit(0) as line:
                line.location_dest_id = self.stock_location.child_ids[0]
                line.quantity = 1

        self.assertEqual(picking.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, self.stock_location.child_ids[0])
test_move_line_destination_location_survives_further_editstest_move.py · TestStockMove
    def test_move_line_destination_location_survives_further_edits(self):
        """ Writing the move's own destination location updates its move
        line's destination when the new value is a child location, but not
        when it's a broader ancestor one - and that doesn't get reset by a
        later quantity edit either. Also, a move reserving from a parent
        location can draw from stock sitting in one of its children. """
        self.env.user.with_user(self.user_stock_manager).write(
            {'group_ids': [Command.link(self.quick_ref('stock.group_stock_multi_locations').id)]})
        child_location = self._create_location('Child')

        consumable = self._create_product(name='Consumable', is_storable=False)
        picking = self._create_picking(self.picking_type_int, moves=[(consumable, 2)])
        picking.action_confirm()
        with Form(picking.move_ids, view='stock.view_stock_move_operations') as form:
            with form.move_line_ids.edit(0) as line:
                line.location_dest_id = child_location
                line.quantity = 1
        self.assertEqual(picking.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, child_location)

        waiting_move = self._out_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=3, validate=False)
        waiting_move._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(waiting_move.state, 'confirmed')

        move = self._create_move(self.product, self.supplier_location, child_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        move._action_confirm()
        move.location_dest_id = self.stock_location
        self.assertEqual(move.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, child_location)

        other_move = self._in_move(self.product, product_uom_qty=1, validate=False)
        other_move._action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(other_move.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, self.stock_location)
        other_move.location_dest_id = child_location
        self.assertEqual(other_move.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, child_location)

        move.move_line_ids.quantity = 3
        self._validate_move(move)
        self.assertEqual(move.move_line_ids.quantity, 3)
        self.assertEqual(move.move_line_ids.location_dest_id, child_location)

        waiting_move._action_assign()
        self.assertEqual(waiting_move.state, 'assigned')

    def test_skip_putaway_if_dest_loc_set_by_user(self):
        """
        Suppose the putaway rules and storage categories enabled. On the
        detailed operations, the user adds a new line, set a specific
        destination location and then the done quantity. In such cases, since
        the user has defined himself the destination location, we should not try
        to apply any putaway rule that would override his choice.

        Additionally, ensure that when a delivery is waiting for availability
        from a parent location, validating a receipt whose destination is a
        child location of that parent triggers the reservation of the delivery.
        """
        self.env.user.write({'group_ids': [(4, self.env.ref('stock.group_stock_multi_locations').id)]})

        child_location = self.stock_location.child_ids[0]

        # Create a delivery from the parent location to the customer location.
        delivery = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_out.id,
            'move_ids': [Command.create({
                'location_id': self.stock_location.id,
                'location_dest_id': self.customer_location.id,
                'product_id': self.productA.id,
                'uom_id': self.productA.uom_id.id,
                'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
            })],
        })
        delivery.action_confirm()
        self.assertEqual(delivery.state, 'confirmed', 'The delivery should be waiting for availability since there is no stock on hand.')

        receipt = self.env['stock.picking'].create({
            'location_id': self.customer_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'picking_type_id': self.picking_type_in.id,
            'move_ids': [(0, 0, {
                'location_id': self.customer_location.id,
                'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
                'product_id': self.productA.id,
                'uom_id': self.productA.uom_id.id,
                'product_uom_qty': 2.0,
            })],
        })
        receipt.action_confirm()

        with Form(receipt.move_ids, view='stock.view_stock_move_operations') as move_form:
            with move_form.move_line_ids.edit(0) as line:
                line.location_dest_id = child_location
                line.quantity = 2

        self.assertRecordValues(receipt.move_ids.move_line_ids[-1], [
            {'location_dest_id': child_location.id, 'product_id': self.productA.id, 'quantity': 2},
        ])
        receipt.button_validate()
        self.assertEqual(receipt.state, 'done')
        self.assertEqual(delivery.state, 'assigned',
                        'The delivery should be assigned since the receipt destination is a child location of the delivery source location.')

    def test_show_quant_and_lot_fields_depend_on_picking_type_lot_settings(self):

            {'show_quant': False, 'show_lots_text': False, 'show_lots_m2o': True},
        ])

            {'show_quant': True, 'show_lots_text': False, 'show_lots_m2o': False},

            {'show_quant': False, 'show_lots_text': True, 'show_lots_m2o': False},
        ])

    def test_move_sn_warning(self):
        """ Check that warnings pop up when duplicate SNs added or when SN isn't in
        expected location.
        Two cases covered:
        - Check for dupes when assigning serial number to a stock move
        - Check for dupes when assigning serial number to a stock move line
        """

        lot1 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({
            'name': 'serial1',
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
        })

        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, self.pack_location, 1, lot_id=lot1)

        move = self.env['stock.move'].create({
            'location_id': self.supplier_location.id,
            'location_dest_id': self.stock_location.id,
            'product_id': self.product_serial.id,
            'uom_id': self.uom_unit.id,
            'product_uom_qty': 1.0,
        })

        move_line = self.env['stock.move.line'].create({
            'move_id': move.id,
            'product_id': move.product_id.id,
            'quantity': 1,
            'uom_id': move.uom_id.id,
            'location_id': move.location_id.id,
            'location_dest_id': move.location_dest_id.id,
            'lot_name': lot1.name,
        })

        warning = False
        warning = move_line._onchange_serial_number()
        self.assertTrue(warning, 'Reuse of existing serial number (name) not detected')
        self.assertEqual(list(warning.keys())[0], 'warning', 'Warning message was not returned')

        move_line.write({
            'lot_name': False,
            'lot_id': lot1.id
        })

        warning = False
        warning = move_line._onchange_serial_number()
        self.assertTrue(warning, 'Reuse of existing serial number (record) not detected')
        self.assertEqual(list(warning.keys())[0], 'warning', 'Warning message was not returned')
        self.assertEqual(move_line.location_id, self.pack_location, 'Location was not auto-corrected')

        move_line.write({
            'lot_name': False,
            'lot_id': False,
        })
        warning = False
        warning = move.onchange({'lot_ids': [Command.link(lot1.id)]}, ['lot_ids'], {'lot_ids': {'context': {}}})
        self.assertTrue(warning, 'Reuse of existing serial number (record) not detected')
        self.assertIn('Unavailable Serial numbers. Please correct the serial numbers encoded', warning.get('warning', {}).get('message'))

    def test_duplicate_serial_number_warns_and_auto_corrects_location(self):
        """ Assigning a serial number already in use elsewhere warns, both at
        the move-line and the move level - and assigning an existing lot by
        id (not just by name) auto-corrects the line's source location to
        where that lot's quant actually is. """
        pack_location = self._create_location('Pack')
        lot1 = self.env['stock.lot'].create({'name': 'serial1', 'product_id': self.product_serial.id})
        self.env['stock.quant']._update_available_quantity(self.product_serial, pack_location, 1, lot_id=lot1)

        move = self._create_move(self.product_serial, self.supplier_location, self.stock_location, product_uom_qty=1)
        move_line = self.env['stock.move.line'].create({
            'move_id': move.id,
            'product_id': move.product_id.id,
            'quantity': 1,
            'uom_id': move.uom_id.id,
            'location_id': move.location_id.id,
            'location_dest_id': move.location_dest_id.id,
            'lot_name': lot1.name,
        })

        warning = move_line._onchange_serial_number()
        self.assertTrue(warning)

        move_line.write({'lot_name': False, 'lot_id': lot1.id})
        warning = move_line._onchange_serial_number()
        self.assertTrue(warning)
        self.assertEqual(move_line.location_id, pack_location)

        move_line.write({'lot_name': False, 'lot_id': False})
        warning = move.onchange({'lot_ids': [Command.link(lot1.id)]}, ['lot_ids'], {'lot_ids': {'context': {}}})
        self.assertIn('Unavailable Serial numbers', warning.get('warning', {}).get('message', ''))
